$description: Trava motion tokens v0. Values chosen by the team on the playground (playground/motion/index.html), 2026-10-05. Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG). Animations must take timing values from here and never invent their own.

enter.$description: Objects appearing. Soft deceleration, no overshoot (principle §1).

standard.$description: Movement from A to B (e.g. impulses along a line, gear turn). Symmetric, calm.

draw.$description: Lines and graphs being drawn. Same curve as standard.

flow.$description: Continuous streams (e.g. impulses flowing along lines). Constant speed, so the stream reads as one steady flow. Added 2026-10-06, ADR 0013.

enter.$description: Offset for fade + shift appearance. In SVG this is user units of the illustration frame, so it scales with the illustration.
Start scale for fade + scale appearance.

threshold.$description: Share of the illustration that must be visible before it starts.

delay.$description: Delay between becoming visible and starting.
